title: RWB-E7-017 the additional-cost claim: its field set, cost types, approval limit, cost table and approval operation
source: Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3 (RWB-E7-017); FSD S9 Partner management v3 A2.14; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T3.1, T3.2, T-A.1; Ownership Map
description: No source gives the additional-cost claim a field catalogue of its own, a cost type list, an approval limit or approving matrix, a table of its own in rwb_partner, an operation that approves or refuses the claim, a value set for result_code, or the AMIS cost interface the legacy data section points at. The claim is therefore carried on partner_instruction (result_code, fee_amount, status) with its evidence in rwb-document, and the approval is a signal on InstructionWorkflow rather than a published route.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E7-017 lists v_ace_npa_asset, partner, decision_log_entry and rule_row and no cost entity; FSD S9 A2.14.3.2 repeats only the partner and partner_instruction fields and gives no cost field; TSD S9 T3.1 has no cost object and T-A.1 has no approval operation; the ownership rows give S9 the three tables partner, partner_user and partner_instruction and six REST operations, none of which approves a claim.
area: S9 rwb-partner, extra costs and services on a held asset
proposed: Confirm the cost line, its field set, the cost type list, the approval limit and the table that carries them; until then the claim rides on partner_instruction and the approval is a workflow signal.

title: RWB-E7-017 the cost claim and the invoice as contract elements, and the event that would announce them
source: TSD S9 Partner management v2 T-A.2, T3.1, T3.2, T5.3; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A2.14; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4
description: API-S9-006 answers Invoice and API-S9-005 answers PartnerInstruction, but no source publishes the fields of InvoiceRequest or Invoice, the cost line of an additional-cost claim, the value set of result_code, an operation that approves a claim, or an event that announces an invoice or an approval. The baseline fixes the element names, the flags and the absence, and publishes EV-21 as the claim's announcement only.
evidence: TSD S9 T-A.2 names the request and the answer of API-S9-004, API-S9-005 and API-S9-006 without a field list; T3.1 catalogues partner and partner_instruction only; T5.3 publishes InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted and no invoice or approval event; the ownership rows give the service two events.
proposed: Publish the two invoice elements, the cost line and the result codes in the baseline review, and confirm that no invoice or approval event is needed.
